description:
Request profile for variants associated with the given gene id. The format
of the gene id is not defined but the use of HUGO gene symbols is *strongly*
recommended.
In its initial design this request profile allows the use of additional parameters
in line with the Beacon v2 use.

parameters such as VRS `type` or CNV type (`copyChange`).
name: GeneIdRequest
